queries.text: How many people were executed during the Reign of Terror in the French Revolution?

revolutionary terror and mass executions in 18th-century Europe

topic.notes: History, but not the history of Finland: the corpus (Suomen historia category tree) has no article on it. Expected: no incidents, ideally an out-of-scope signal. Shares words with the 1918 Red and White terror, which is the trap.
